windows.action: A phone sealed in an evidence bag sits on a dark table; Lynn answers questions straight to camera. By the last shot she has dropped her eyes from the lens and is talking down at the table.
On black, a multiple-choice answer sheet builds itself row by row, from question 1 with four blank bubbles to row 12 where a bubble fills in and a Thai name appears beneath it.
Hands open a black portfolio labelled with Lynn's name and turn to a school certificate inside; the camera then pulls back to a glass-walled office where two people sit at desks.
Lynn in school uniform and her father sit before the administrator, trophies on her desk; from the wide two-shot it tightens to Lynn alone, then to a press clipping naming her crossword champion.

Lynn's father talks up her record, smiling, then pushes the trophies across the desk towards the administrator; the moment ends on Lynn, who has turned from her father to face the woman with a small smile.

Lynn's father pitches her record; the school director answers with a warm smile. A wide shows the pair seated side by side behind the trophies, then the camera retreats outside the office, watching all three small through glass partitions.
The director leans in explaining something; cut to Lynn as the figure "120,000" appears handwritten beside her head. She shifts from silently listening to speaking back at the desk.
Handwritten sums start crawling over the frame: the father looks off, counting fares; Lynn's column of arithmetic fills her shot; by the director's close-up the running total has reached 13,600 baht.

Insert of the father's hand settling over Lynn's on her lap, the sums still floating. A wide holds both under the figures, then Lynn's close-up as the last line resolves to 75% and her face stays unreadable.

The overlaid numbers are gone. The director sits back smiling; the father breaks into a wide grin beside the trophies; a shot from behind both of them shows her across the desk, hands clasped over the paperwork.

Lynn and her father sit across a desk from a smiling woman in a white blouse in a school office. The angle flips from her side of the desk to theirs, Lynn watching warily while her father stays composed.
Close coverage of the meeting: the woman talks warmly, the father listens flat-faced behind his glasses, and by the last shot Lynn has softened from guarded into a small smile.
Inserts of the school enrolment form for academic year 2557: the printed header, a pen tracking along a dotted line, then the nickname field filled in with 'Lin'.
Lynn faces the lens dead-on against a red backdrop for her ID photo, unsmiling; the image then drains to black and white, turning her into a finished document portrait.
A large Thai title card reads M.4 over a student seated at the red photo backdrop; time has jumped. Cut to schoolgirls' legs queueing up stone steps, then a rack focus off a blurred white uniform.

Grace steps up to Lynn at the red backdrop and starts smoothing her hair with both hands while Lynn stares off, enduring it. Intercut with Grace chatting brightly in the sunlit corridor and a pair of black school shoes waiting in line.

The grooming continues in cross-cut: Grace talks over someone's shoulder in the bright corridor, Lynn stands stiff at the backdrop, and Grace ends up pushing Lynn's fringe off her forehead as Lynn flinches back.

Grace wais to the photographer at his tripod, then mugs and finally grins wide at the lens. Cut against Lynn at the backdrop, blank behind her glasses, then with the glasses gone, eyes sliding away from camera.

Grace stands against a flat red wall in school uniform, holding a faint smile for an unseen camera; the film then cuts away to a bright school corridor where a bespectacled student ties back her hair.

Quick cards of the same girl on red - a form inked with the nickname 'Grace', then a wide grin, then the portrait in black and white - before the image tips over into an upside-down blur of her face on a dark table.
Grace sits alone at a bare wooden table in a dark room, hands clasped, talking straight into the lens; across the long take she leans in and her loose smile tightens into something more insistent.

A wide down the library stacks shows two schoolgirls sitting facing each other on the floor; the cut goes in close as one talks with a hand up at the shelf, then to the girl with the blue ribbon answering in profile.

Reverse angles continue between the two on the floor - a flat, guarded look softens into a smile as the other presses her point - and the wide returns with a pink booklet now out on the stack of books between them.
In the library stacks a girl turns sharply, startled; the reverse shows the two of them now talking face to face through a gap in the shelves, Grace leaning in close to Lynn.
They settle on the library floor with books spread around them; an insert shows a Thai maths exam paper, then the two heads come together over it, Lynn talking while Grace studies the page.
Shot/reverse over the pink answer sheet as Lynn works the problem through; Grace puts a hand on her shoulder, and by the last shot her face has opened into wide-eyed astonishment.
Grace breaks into a delighted grin and keeps talking; Lynn stays flat, eyes drifting up and away, and by the last shot she is still looking off while Grace's hand reaches toward her.
One long held two-shot: Grace beams at the paper while Lynn keeps her eyes down; across the take Lynn turns and Grace ends up talking straight into her face.
Lynn finally cracks, laughing with her eyes shut as Grace leans into her; they end up clapping hands together, and the wide pulls back to leave them laughing on the library floor.
Hard cut to a dark bare room: Lynn alone in a striped shirt behind an empty table, facing the camera head on and holding still, unsmiling, for the whole shot.
A Thai title card over a wide classroom of uniformed students at the midterm; the camera then drops in to Lynn at her desk, head down, fist against her cheek as she starts to write.
Grace twists round in her seat to look back; Lynn meets her eyes from the row behind. By the last shot Grace has turned forward again and dropped her gaze.
Lynn reads her paper; the teacher stands at the board under "midterm exam - mathematics". Inserts of the answer sheet, the header reading 60 questions / 30 marks, a pen nib, then hands begin writing.
Grace bends over her sheet, hand flat on the page while the student next to her writes steadily. By the last shot her page is still blank and her face has only sunk lower.
A Venn-diagram question on the white exam paper cuts to a black-and-white memory of Grace and Lynn studying on the library floor over a pink worksheet, then to that worksheet: the same question.
Grace flips to the next page and keeps checking: a shaded Venn on the white exam against the identical shaded Venn on the pink sheet. Her hand ends the moment resting, still not answering.
The cutting accelerates - white exam questions 10/11 and 17/18 matched against the pink worksheet's 11/12 and 18, identical wording - with Grace's lowered face in the middle of the run.
Grace lifts her head and stares dead ahead, stunned. The angle widens behind her: classmates with heads in their hands, and Lynn in the foreground chewing her fingernail.
Grace turns her head to scan the room - a girl in glasses working beside her, then the teacher at the front desk with his head down over his phone, not watching anyone.
Grace looks off to the side, brow creased and close to panic; cut to Lynn in her own row, eyes down, biting at her fingernail. Neither is writing.
Grace twists round with her paper and whispers back to Lynn; the reverse holds on Lynn, whose face goes from alert reply to a pained grimace by the last shot.

Insert of the classroom wall map, then a wide of the silent exam room and a sweating girl bent over her paper; the moment ends on the proctor standing with his back to camera, surveying the full rows of desks.
Close on the sweating student labouring over her paper, then the camera moves behind the rows of ponytailed heads all facing the whiteboard, pulling the focus off her and onto the whole hall.
Grace writes with a small pleased smile, an insert catches a hand clicking a pen, then a wide finds Lynn working steadily alone at her desk while the students around her slump and clutch their heads.

Fast inserts of the maths paper: algebra questions, bubbles already blacked in on the answer sheet, Lynn's page flipped over in a blur, then a macro of the pen tip filling one more circle. The sheet goes from part-done to deep into the paper.
Extreme close-ups of a sweating student's face cut against question 51 and the answer grid; her eyes drop, then shut entirely, while the pen beside her keeps inking rows 50-52.
The proctor slouches at the front desk stifling a yawn; cut wide to the hall where Lynn, alone among the bent heads, has lifted her eyes off her paper and is watching him.

Lynn's hand holds up a metal pen, macro on its tip, then she sits back at her desk working something small in her fingers; the insert reveals Thai answer letters written along the side of a white eraser laid over the answer sheet.

Grace writes with her head down, then the shot holds on the back of Lynn's blue-ribboned head as she checks the front of the room; Grace's head snaps up, eyes wide and expectant, and the moment cuts back to Lynn still facing away.

Under the desks Lynn slips her foot out of her shoe, reaches down and drops the pink eraser inside it; she then turns and looks back over her shoulder, and above the desks she and Grace lock eyes across the aisle.

Under the exam desks a socked foot eases out of a black school shoe; Lynn's face is sweating and set, and by the last shot her eyes are screwed shut with effort while the proctor sits unaware at the front.

The bare foot shoves the shoe clear and withdraws, leaving it standing alone on the tiles. Grace half-smiles over her shoulder; the proctor leans forward on his desk, and Lynn keeps writing with Grace in front of her.
Fast low-angle cuts of the proctor's black shoes stepping between the desk legs, closing in; the run ends with him passing right behind Grace, who keeps her head down over her paper.
Wide on the full exam room with the proctor at the edge of frame; then in close, Grace keeps her eyes down while Lynn, behind her, glances sideways at her.
Close on the pair of shoes tucked under a desk beside socked feet; one is kicked out and skids blurred across the tiles, ending upright and alone on open floor between the rows.
Lynn leans in and whispers to Grace at the next desk; cut to the shoe stranded in the open aisle near other students' feet, then back to Lynn staring wide-eyed while Grace faces front.

Insert of hands turning the question sheet over the bubbled answer card; Grace lowers her head while Lynn watches, and the shot ends on the shoe sitting out in the aisle in full view of the proctor's desk.
Grace stands at her desk, expressionless, then walks the length of the room to the proctor's table at the whiteboard, leaving her seat empty behind her.

Mid-exam a student stands at the invigilator's desk; under the rows a black shoe sits between stockinged feet and Lynn stretches across her desk toward it. A hand digs inside the shoe and lifts out an eraser covered in pencilled answers.
Grace grins down at her answer sheet as she writes; Lynn bends over the teacher's desk to hand her paper in. By the last shot Grace is sitting back with a red lollipop in her mouth, eyes closed.

Hands open a blue student report book with a photo and ID 311790, and the camera pushes in on the grade 3.87. Cut wide to the empty school lobby, where two girls meet and the blue book passes between them.

Lynn and Grace talk face to face in the sunlit corridor, cut close on each. Grace laughs and gushes while Lynn answers evenly; by the final shot Grace is hugging the blue report book, smiling up at her.
A white robe stitched Patton Hotel Bangkok fills the frame, then night: a girl is hit by a sheet of water in a lit rooftop pool and Pat surges up shirtless through the spray.
Pat stands chest-deep talking to Lynn and Grace across the pool, then pulls a wide-eyed clown face at them and sweeps water over them; both girls end up ducking behind their hands.
Champagne chills in a brass ice bucket beside two empty flutes at the pool edge; focus drifts to a girl floating in the blue water, then hands twist the cork and the bottle sprays out over her.
Pat talks straight to camera against a flat red wall, cut with a pen signing a 10,875.48 hotel bill. He pushes his hair back and the last shot drops to a black-and-white portrait of him, smiling.

A champagne flute held at the pool edge opens out to a wide of a lit rooftop pool at night, Lynn robed on the rim, Grace swimming, Pat adrift on an inflatable; it closes tight on Pat floating with a bottle, eyes shut.
Lynn talks across the water from the pool edge and Pat answers grinning from his float; Grace surfaces in goggles to join in, and by the last shot Lynn is laughing and looking away.
Pat keeps talking from the float and Lynn drops her eyes; his grin falls into wide-eyed alarm, and she comes back at him with a strained, pained face.
From a waterline shot of Pat's bottle hand, Lynn leans in over his shoulder and presses her case while Grace watches from the water; Lynn ends turned away in profile, no longer facing him.
Pat ducks his head and slicks his wet hair back beside the float as Lynn stares down at the deck with her eyes closed; Grace pushes her goggles up onto her forehead and surfaces into the argument.
Pat bursts out laughing and slaps a sheet of water into the air; Lynn lifts her head and looks past him, weighing it, while Pat drifts to the pool wall and goes quiet, staring off.
Lynn listens on a dark street strung with bokeh lights; the cut goes to Pat answering from a lit night pool, bottle in hand. She starts talking back, and Grace surfaces at the pool edge in goggles.
Pat leans on the pool wall pitching, bottle raised; Lynn drops her eyes and goes quiet. He gestures harder, grinning, while Grace floats behind him with her eyes shut.
Lynn stands head down, then lifts a hand to her chin, weighing it; Pat keeps smiling at the pool edge and brings the phone back to his ear. She shifts from just listening to considering.
Lynn bows her head on the street; the cut then holds long on Pat and Grace side by side at the pool wall, both talking up into the call. She is alone on her end, they are a pair on theirs.
Lynn turns her face away mid-call; Pat pulls Grace in under his arm as he keeps talking. By the last shot Lynn's eyes have dropped and she has stopped answering.
Hands ease open a dark cabinet drawer in a dim room; Lynn crouches at the desk under framed certificates and lifts out a sealed official document, now held up close and readable.
Seen through a doorway she settles at the lamplit desk and sorts the papers, an arm sweeping across the pile; the last shot pushes in close on her face, lowered and unmoving as she reads.
She lifts an ornate award certificate out of the stack; a framed photo of her father holding her as a baby sits on the shelf beside her. By the last shot she is reading another sheet, face set.
Daylight, one long take: close on Lynn's hands moving over the piano keys, then focus racks past her blurred shoulder to her father, in a white vest, appearing in the room behind her.
Lynn plays on in profile, eyes forward; in the wide shot her father crosses the room behind her and goes out through the archway. Left alone, she lowers her head over the keys.
Past Lynn's shoulder, her father pulls open the fridge and rummages inside. Cut back: she has lifted her head from the keys and is staring away, no longer playing.
Seen past Lynn's blurred shoulder, her father stands in the kitchen in a vest holding a white bottle. The cut reverses to Lynn at the piano, watching him steadily.
Her father tips a pill into his hand and swallows it; Lynn drops her eyes. By the last shot he has set the bottle down and crosses the room toward her, smiling.
A long held take: her father's shoulder enters the foreground as he reaches the piano and talks to her. Lynn, first facing him, ends with her back to camera, head tilted up toward the window.
Tight inserts close in on the piano: the brass pedals on scratched wood, a face reflected in the dark glass past Lynn's shoulder, then her face in profile lowering as she settles to play.
One unbroken shot of Lynn's hands on the Kriebel keyboard. The camera pushes in from her seated body to the hands alone, her fingers moving across the keys.
Lynn is glimpsed through a wooden lattice, head down and half-smiling. Back at the piano she folds the fallboard shut and the frame widens to her alone with the closed instrument.
In a dim room Lynn sits at an upright piano with a hand on the keys; cut to a student alone at a bare table in the dark, hands clasped, who drops his eyes before the frame goes black.

Daylight music room: Lynn stands by the piano with her eyes shut, then her fingers settle on the keys and she lifts a hand as she explains. The cut pulls back to six students sitting in rows, watching her.
Close on Lynn's fingers walking across the keys while she talks over her shoulder. The group, first a loose row, is now crowded in tight on the sofa, leaning forward at her hand.
Lynn, backlit at the barred window, keeps explaining, intercut with her hand running the pattern. By the end she has turned to the piano and is playing it herself rather than describing it.
Wide over the students' heads: Lynn sits at the piano smiling at them; they stare back blank and unmoved. She ends on her feet beside the piano, alone in frame, facing them down.

School exam hall. Grace glances sideways at her desk; a wall clock and the paper header reading final exam 2/2557, 8.30-10.30. She sits back chewing her pencil, and a classmate's hand flattens on the desk edge.
Lynn sits an exam, pencil at her lips, then lays her hand flat on the desk edge and works her fingers; the cut lands on those same fingers running over piano keys.
At home Grace and Pat drill the fingering on their knees; in the exam room Grace sits watching for Lynn's hand, and the moment ends on a pen tip settling into a circled answer.

The code spreads: piano keys, a hand ticking on a desk, more clients mouthing it back at the house, bubbles filled in. By the end the scheme is outdoors, a black sedan at the school gate and Pat on his phone beside it.
Lynn works the piano at home while boy after boy in the exam room grins back at the tapping hand and sheets fill in; it closes on Lynn's face, eyes down, giving nothing away.
A hand sketches on paper, then a bank book opens on rows of deposits climbing into the hundreds of thousands. The scene turns to Lynn's house after dark, her father standing across the dim room.
Lynn turns from the piano and her clients whoop in the living room; back in the dark house she sits at her study desk answering her father, and the last shot leaves him standing alone, silent.
Lynn lifts her chin in the bright classroom with a small smile; the film cuts to her alone at night working a school photocopier, and ends pulled into blur.
In a school walkway Pat leans in close to Lynn's ear while a classmate watches; the next shot has four students lined up grinning straight at the camera.
A low angle on the school tower, figures on the roof handling a banner; the camera then holds on the hung banner itself, a student's portrait and a congratulation on her scholarship.
Bank's portrait against a red backdrop drains to black and white, then a Thai title card comes up over a school toilet block, the focus settling on the stalls behind the lettering.
In the toilets Bank's face screws up and he doubles over; hands then hold up a name card reading 'Bank' and pin it to his shirt, and a wide finds him bent over the sink, composed again.
Seen from the wings, a suited host works the blue quiz-show set; Lynn stands against the corridor wall applauding with her eyes shut, and the cut moves back to Bank clapping in profile.
Cut to a dark green room: a boy in a blue sweater, first seen in profile, turns to face front, alone at a bare table with a single glass of water, and begins to speak.
Bank crosses the wings towards the lit stage, Lynn standing off to his right; the cut then holds on his face in profile, stopped now, watching the set instead of moving.
Lynn keeps her eyes closed against the wall while Bank, now planted in front of her, lowers his head and talks; by the end of the long wide he has turned off the stage to face her.
Lynn stands against a wood-panelled wall facing Bank. She holds his eye at first, then drops her gaze and shuts her eyes, while he keeps staring at her from the dark side of the room.
Lynn argues her case, lit warm against the panelling; Bank listens in silhouette by the studio lamp. She goes from guarded to insistent and is still talking when he looks away without answering.
A wide catches Lynn laying a hand on Bank in the lit set doorway; back in close-up she holds out a fist. He stares at it, then raises his own and bumps it - the pact is made.
The bump over, neither will look at the other. Lynn turns to profile, Bank's eyes drift off, and the last shots leave her ponytail to the camera and him staring into the dark.
Cut to the bright blue Teen Genius studio: Lynn and Bank sit side by side at the contestant desk with mics, then the suited host steps into frame in front of the logo to open the show.

In a sunlit office the bobbed woman in the white blouse perches on the desk with a tablet, smiling at a student. Lynn and Bank stand stiffly in the doorway; by the end she is talking at them and neither has moved.

The woman in white sweeps into the meeting room laughing and crosses to the long table; Lynn and Bank, tense in the doorway, soften. She ends seated across from them, hands clasped, pitching something.
Shot/reverse across the table as the woman keeps talking and smiling. Bank's face goes from startled to blank; by the last reverse she has leaned forward over clasped hands, no longer smiling.
Tight profiles: Lynn stares ahead, jaw set and unhappy, with Bank blurred behind her; the cut reverses and it is Bank who answers while Lynn turns away out of focus.
Night. A motorbike headlight flares at camera, then Bank pulls on a battered helmet with earphones in. He ends wheeling the bike off the street into the lit laundry shopfront.

Bank walks into the family laundry shop at night past the parked motorbike; inside, a hand lifts a framed certificate beside a memorial portrait, and the last shot finds the shop still working behind its lit window.
From a dark doorway Bank watches his mother crouched over laundry by the washing machines. He stops with an earphone still in, and the moment closes tight on her soapy hands scrubbing cloth.
His textbook lies abandoned on a stool. Bank, changed into shorts and a tee, steps in beside his mother at the tubs, and by the last shot he is the one sitting there scrubbing alone.
Lynn sits alone in near-darkness, eyes lowered. Across the held close-ups she raises her head and stares off, the look hardening from defeat into something decided.
Bank crosses a school walkway head down, sorting his bag. A classmate in glasses catches him up talking, and the two end up walking away together down the corridor, the classmate turning in on him.

Stopped in the bright corridor, the classmate in glasses pitches something to Bank with open hands. Bank's first look back is wary and narrow; by the last reverse he has softened into a half-smile while the other keeps selling it.
The classmate keeps pressing his point while Bank stares at him in disbelief. The camera finally pulls back to a cold wide of the two facing off alone on the walkway.
Bank breaks away and strides past camera down the corridor, jaw tight; the classmate hurries after him, still talking, and is left behind in the background.
Close on an earphone in Bank's ear, then a high wide of the near-empty exam hall ruled with white tape. Bank sits with eyes shut, then opens them and turns to scan the filling room.
Candidates file in and find their desks: Pat walks the aisle past seated students, then a ponytailed girl crosses the empty floor as a proctor seats others at the back.
Bank, seated, glances off to the side; a proctor moves along the rows dropping papers on desks; Bank then squares up to face front, eyes fixed straight at camera.

Bank sits alone at a desk in a huge exam gym, staring forward. The camera widens to Lynn and a bespectacled boy in the same row, then pulls all the way back to the full hall with the proctor standing at the front desk.
Bank lowers his eyes to his paper and starts filling the header. Macro inserts follow the pencil and pen writing the class line, ending on the half-written 'ม 5/' before the name field.
The row settles into work, pencils shading bubbles. Bank, calm at the start, is sweating in close-up by the second half, and the last insert shows the pencil stalled in the 39-40 block.
Pat writes steadily, then lifts his head; cut to the proctor at his lamp-lit desk, head down marking. By the last shot the proctor has looked straight up at the hall, catching the movement.
Lynn stands over her desk, face hard, then in close-up presses a hand to her mouth. A boy nearby props his cheek, bored; Lynn's final close-up has her eyes gone wide and fixed on the page.
Lynn lifts her booklet and reads the cover; insert reveals the label 'ก. ชุดที่ 1'. Cut to Bank bowed over his own sheet, then a macro of question 40 where a filled bubble has been rubbed out.
Pat works head-down while a girl behind turns her pages; Bank, in profile, raises his eyes off the paper for the first time. The hall wide shot follows, then the focus slips and the rows blur out.

Pat sits in the middle of the packed exam hall, mouth working as he stares ahead; cut to an invigilator's hand carrying papers and a pen down the aisle. By the last shot the invigilator is right beside the desks and Pat has dropped his eyes.

A blurred girl bows over her paper, then a wide of rows of students writing; overhead inserts show a hand with a calculator watch pressing a pencil across the bubble sheet. Lynn twists round to check behind her, and the sheet is far fuller by the last insert.
Pat leans low over his desk, whispering urgently at Lynn; she turns back over her shoulder to answer him. He presses again, and by the last shot she has turned forward with a small, closed smile.
Tight on Grace at her desk, brow tight as she watches off-screen; cut wide to Lynn, who swivels in her seat with the pencil still in her fingers and stares straight back down the hall.

Bank stands over the invigilator's desk under the green lamp, talking down at the seated man; the invigilator reaches a hand out towards him. Bank's eyes drop, and by the last shot a second invigilator in uniform has come to the desk.

Past the lamp, the hall is a silent grid of heads down over papers. Bank keeps talking at the desk; the invigilator folds his arms and sits back, and in the last shot he is leaning away entirely, chin up, looking past Bank.
A proctor lolls at his desk under a green lamp while students bend over papers behind him. A girl twists in her seat, and the shot settles on Lynn, upright and staring off, not writing.

Bank works head-down behind his glasses; a close-up finds Lynn tense in thought; Pat watches her from across the aisle. By the last shot the proctor has slumped back and is stretching, eyes off the room.
A long hold on Lynn from behind, fist pressed to her mouth, the hall quiet around her; the moment ends on a macro insert of her paper's header reading 'Set 1'.
A heavyset boy and Grace sit waiting instead of writing, looking up across the hall. It closes tight on Grace, hand at her neck, dropping her eyes back down to her paper.
The answer goes out as finger taps: a hand drums the desk in close-up, the frame widens to show the hall of candidates behind it, then a boy taps with one hand while writing with the other.
The code lands. A heavyset boy writes steadily, a pencil blacks in a bubble in macro, fingers keep tapping, and by the last shots a girl and a boy further back are both filling in answers.
A wall clock nears ten and a sweating girl screws up her face; then taps and blackened bubbles, 56 then 40, cut faster as Pat drums while writing, ending on a girl glancing at the boy beside her.
A girl pushes up from her desk in the exam hall; wide on rows of students writing at spaced desks. By the last shot the proctor at his lamp-lit desk has looked up and is tracking her.

Lynn twists round and mouths something at a boy in glasses across the aisle; he grimaces back. Behind them students start carrying papers up to the proctor, and by the end Lynn has turned away, face set.

Hands shove exam papers across the proctor's desk; close on a booklet header filled in for M.5/1. The crowd files out, a wall clock reads just past 10:08, and the proctor is left alone at the empty desk.
Lynn stands at her desk in the gym, head down; a pencil blacks in a bubble. She and the boy in glasses trade strained, sweating grimaces across the aisle until he finally breaks into a grin.
Grace bends over her paper; a hand works longhand maths, then fills bubbles on the answer sheet. The working sheet is a mess of erased lines, and the wall clock has moved on to 10:20.

Grace lifts her head and looks off across the thinning hall, then sits head-on with her pen down, waiting. Another girl stays hunched with her back turned, a bubble is inked, and Pat checks his watch.
Macro of graphite on paper, then Lynn leans low and taps a rhythm along her pen. Pat scratches the back of his head and grins her way; a hand drops below the desk and drums its fingers on the floor.
Lynn counts the code off on her fingers against the pen, brow knotting. Cut to the proctor dead centre staring out at the room, then a whip pan to a wide where only a handful of students are left.

Close-ups of a pencil filling answer bubbles, then a wide of Lynn stretching at her desk in the half-empty hall; a whip-pan lands on Grace glancing round and ends on Lynn, arms behind her head, eyes shut.

A hand drops onto the desk and an insert shows the paper header 'KHO. Set 2'. By the end the fingers sit splayed and drumming on the tabletop while Grace writes and a hand sweeps a dense printed sheet.

Around the hall the code is received: a boy scribbles with Grace behind him, Lynn's head comes up, Bank mouths along, a pen fills a sheet; it ends on Pat leaning forward, then his hand flat on the desk.
Cut to the invigilator's desk - his hand on dark wood, then he mops his face. Back on Lynn, sweating, her hand still drumming the desk, until the last shot has her bent low over her paper, writing.
The invigilator tips his head back singing to himself, then stands at his lamp-lit desk swinging both arms. Grace twists round and Pat looks up; the moment ends with Bank staring over his glasses.
Lynn sweats over her paper, left hand tapping while her right hand writes. Then the invigilator steps out from behind his desk into the hall; Grace's head snaps up and Lynn looks off, alert.

An insert of a finger on the bubble grid; the invigilator walks straight down the aisle toward camera. Lynn breathes hard, a hand keeps writing as his legs pass, and he stops to lean over a girl's desk.
Lynn looks up, tense; the invigilator stands over a student, looking down at the desk. By the last shot Lynn has turned to profile, face settled and calm again, eyes forward.
In the exam hall a bespectacled invigilator leans in, takes a folded note from a seated girl, then moves off down the aisle to another student. Lynn twists round in her seat, watching, tense.
A phone screen fills with a LINE group chat; outside, Pat scrolls his phone on the steps while Grace braids Lynn's hair. A boy by the doorway grins at his own screen - the message has spread.
A grey-haired teacher in a tie steps out of the doorway and passes the steps. The easy mood drops: the three look up after him, and Grace rises to her feet as he walks by.
A close-up of a dark office doorknob; the door swings and students push through, one wide-eyed. Inside, a woman behind a desk faces a seated man as two students stand waiting.
Pat works at a laptop with Bank and a girl leaning over him. The camera whips off them to the teacher in the tie, head down, and follows a man crossing the office toward the woman at the desk.
Lynn and Bank stand side by side in a school office, eyes down; the shot cuts away to the teacher in the blue shirt at her desk, flipping through a stack of answer sheets.

Wide of the pair standing before the desk with a second teacher seated nearby; the teacher looks up and speaks, and by the last shot Bank has turned his head toward Lynn while she stares straight ahead.

A blurred rush of movement breaks the standoff: the teacher drops her eyes to the desk, Lynn pushes past the door frame and out of the office, and a boy stops in the glass doorway to look back after her.
Back inside, the teacher is on her feet holding a sheet, smiling as she talks past Bank by the window; the cut leaves Lynn alone facing the room, a man seated at her shoulder, her face blank.
A garlanded statue of the Virgin Mary on a wooden shrine, then Grace in close-up with hands pressed together and eyes shut, lips moving in prayer.
The angle widens to show Pat lounging on the bench below the shrine with snacks while Grace keeps praying; by the end she has broken off and turned to look back at him over her shoulder.

Seen through the office glass: a woman in dark blouse seated left, Lynn standing at the blinds, her father seated right. The camera closes in from the wide group to the father's worried face, then to Lynn alone in profile, turned away.
A dark, blocked over-shoulder of Lynn at the window gives way to a clear frame of her turning to face the room; her father then swings his head round toward her.
Pat, in school uniform, talks and jabs his finger off-screen. The cuts leave him for the listeners: the woman in dark blouse frowning, then Lynn's father staring off with his mouth half open.
A long held shot of Lynn standing against the bright blinds, head lowered and eyes down. She says nothing and never raises her head across the whole take.
The woman in dark blouse, in profile, looks away as she speaks; the father answers in close-up; the cut returns to Lynn, still standing with her head bowed, unchanged.

One sustained wide opens the room out: Lynn standing at left, her father seated at the desk centre, and Pat now visible standing apart at the right, with the woman's back in the foreground. Nobody moves; the father's head stays down.
In a school office the woman in the navy blouse talks at Lynn, who stands in uniform with her head down. By the last shot Lynn has raised her eyes and is looking straight back at her.
The camera goes round the room: Lynn's father sits hunched in his chair, Lynn stands by the blinds, Bank waits in the dark at the back. The last shot widens to put Lynn standing over her father.
The woman's face twists as she lays into them and Lynn turns to answer back. The moment ends with the woman rising out of her chair, the frame blurred by her movement.
On her feet now, the woman faces Lynn across the glass partition and Lynn argues back; the father grimaces in his seat. The last shot pulls outside the office to show the three spread apart.
Lynn's father sits with his head sunk, then pushes up out of the chair and bends forward, pleading. Cut to the woman back at her desk, hands folded, looking up at him with a thin, unmoved smile.
Lynn stares ahead in profile and Bank keeps his eyes down. The wide shot then finds all three lined up in front of the desk, the father holding Lynn's hand as they stand to hear the verdict.
In the headmistress's office Lynn stands and talks; a wide shot shows her lined up at the desk with her father and Bank. The headmistress goes from listening in profile to looking up, stricken.
Lynn's father stands with his eyes down, then he and Bank move out through the office doorway; the moment ends on Bank, head lowered, with Lynn's back filling the foreground.
A dark interview room: focus pulls from a sweating glass of water to Bank talking, an insert shows the school's scholarship banner outside, then he is alone at the long table still answering.
A hand tilts a bank passbook open to Lynn's name, then at home her father stands over the dining table where she sits; by the end of the long take he has leaned in across it toward her.
Close on Lynn, jaw set, looking past him; the film cuts to her father standing over her in close-up, talking steadily down at her, his expression hardening as he goes on.
Back and forth: Lynn stares off, the wide shot shows her father braced on the table across from her, and when it returns to her face her eyes have reddened and her mouth is pulling tight.

Her father presses a hand to his chest, then starts unbuttoning his shirt as he argues; Lynn's eyes fill. By the wide shot he is in a white undershirt, stepping away from the table and leaving her seated alone.
Lynn sits in school uniform by a barred window, staring off to the side. Across the held take she drops her head and her face crumples into tears.
Tight on a woman in a polka-dot blouse against a dark wall, eyes down; an insert shows her hands twisting the ring on her finger. She wipes her eyes, then lifts her face, composed again.

In a wood-panelled restaurant a thumb cracks open a cold soda can. The woman in the striped shirt sips and talks brightly; Lynn, in a yellow t-shirt opposite, stares back blankly while the woman ends up beaming and holding the can up to her.
The woman shuts her eyes and savours the drink, pitching hard across the table. Lynn gives nothing back, and by the last shot the woman has lowered the can and her grin has shrunk to a thin smile.
Lynn finally speaks, flat and brief; the woman looks down and away with a faint smile, then Lynn goes blank again. The camera pulls back to a dark wide of the empty restaurant, the pair out of frame.

At the panelled restaurant table the man in the grey suit tips his wine glass up to drain the last drop; Lynn and Pat laugh along. By the last shot the glass is down and empty in the foreground and Pat is talking back to him.

Wide of the almost empty dining room as Pat stands and steps away from the table, leaving Lynn alone with the couple. Lynn turns to the woman in the cream jacket, who smiles back at her across the cloth.
The woman in the cream jacket talks on with her eyes closed. Opposite her Lynn's smile thins and she lowers her gaze to the table instead of answering.
The woman leans in, smiling, and presses her point; Lynn lifts her head again and breaks into an open laugh, the awkwardness of the previous exchange dropped.
The man in the grey suit takes over the table, talking at Lynn with growing animation. She listens in profile without smiling, and by the last shot her lips have parted as if she is about to reply.

In a wood-panelled restaurant a young woman listens across the table while an older man in a grey jacket talks and gestures over the wine glasses; her smile fades, and the last shot finds Pat walking back to the table with a bottle.
Shot past the wine glasses, the young woman is turned away from camera as the man keeps talking; by the end she has swung back to face him, guarded now rather than amused.
The man leans in with an easy grin, still selling; the cut back replaces the woman's wary look with a small pleased smile as she tilts her head toward him.

An older woman in tweed holds up a Boston University brochure and talks it through; inserts show hands sliding it across the cream cloth to the young woman, who looks down smiling, and it ends lying open on the table.

A brighter room: a girl in a yellow T-shirt sits with her head lowered while a woman in a striped shirt talks warmly across the table; by the last shot the girl has lifted her eyes and the woman is grinning.
The girl now holds the woman's gaze flatly; the woman leans closer and talks faster, and the moment ends on a defocused insert of the Boston University brochure lying on the cloth between them.
Close on the woman, wide-eyed and smiling as she presses her case; the long held final shot stays on the girl, who folds her hands on the table and gives nothing back, her face closing.
In a wood-panelled room a smiling woman in a striped shirt talks across to Lynn, who listens in her yellow volunteer T-shirt. By the end Lynn has lifted a white envelope into frame and holds it.

Elevator doors slide shut on a figure glimpsed through the gap; then Lynn rides a mall escalator, turning to glance back over her shoulder, ending on a blurred insert of hands carrying an orange booklet and a shop bag.

Lynn stands back from a hotel reception desk lined with world clocks, then moves in and leans on the counter talking to the receptionist; by the last shot her hand is writing Thai on a card beside the orange booklets.
Lynn pushes the booklet and card across the marble counter, eyes down; the angle then swings to her profile, face set and waiting, a man working blurred behind her.
Lynn waits at a hotel reception counter, papers in front of her, while the clerk takes a phone call; the shot then cuts to a hand holding up a phone showing a snapshot of a man and a small girl.
Lynn stands under the lobby chandelier staring up, face slowly tightening across a long held take; cut to a wall clock labelled NEW YORK, then back to her, mouth now open as it lands.
Two clocks, NEW YORK and LONDON, sit side by side; Lynn's lifted face answers them, and the camera pulls back to a wide of her small at the counter beneath a whole row of world clocks.
Lynn's eyes travel the clock wall to one marked SYDNEY; a high angle catches her looking straight up, and the last shot turns her away from us, back to camera, facing the clocks, decided.

A hand pushes a red pin flag down onto Australia on a world map; cut to a print workshop seen through its glass partitions, then back to the flag now standing upright with the hand laid flat beside it.

Lynn and Pat slump on their elbows over the flagged map in the print shop while Grace stands across the table talking at them; a hand reaches in to point at Australia and Grace keeps pitching, unanswered.
Lynn stands over a world map spread on the print-shop table, pitching to a seated Grace and Pat. Grace starts slumped on her hands; by the last shot both sit up, Pat gesturing back at Lynn.
Tighter, darker coverage as Lynn keeps explaining, eyes down. Pat argues back across the map, Grace frowning beside him; by the end Pat has gone quiet with a hand at his chin, working it out.
Lynn finishes, still unsmiling. Grace breaks into a laugh, then springs out of her chair in a wide shot and throws herself at Lynn in a hug, leaving Lynn held and faintly smiling.
Grace and Pat lean over the map, Pat spreading his hand across it and talking up at Lynn. Cut to Lynn alone in profile against a bright barred window, turned away and no longer smiling.
Lynn stands in profile at a bright barred window, talking. Cut to Grace and Pat at a table covered with a world map, looking up at her; by the last shot Pat has clapped a hand over his mouth.
Lynn keeps talking at the window while Pat drops his hand and sits thinking, chin propped. In the last shot Lynn has crossed the room and stands over the table, looking down at them.
Night. Bank rides his laundry scooter down a wet street, shot from behind with cars sliding past, then the camera flips to face him head-on with his headlight burning into the lens.
One long take at a green gate: Bank parks, unties the bungee cords and works the big laundry basket loose from the bike, ending hunched over it alone in the dark.
A windscreen POV from a parked car watches Bank carry the basket; a figure sits in the driver's seat as the door is opened. Bank stops and turns to stare straight back at the car.
Black-and-white CCTV, timecode running 19:53:21 to 19:53:26: men stand around Bank at the gate, then rush him and drag him down beside the pickup truck.
Extreme close-up of Bank's face, one eye swollen shut and bloodied. The camera pulls back to show him lying in rubbish, then a wide shot of him sprawled alone on a vast landfill.
windows.censor_note: blood and a swollen, split eye wound fill the frame in the close-up and remain prominent in the following shot

windows.action: Bank lies unconscious in a landfill, face bloodied; a wide shot finds him sprawled on the rubbish slope, and by the last shot he has hauled himself upright, a speck sitting alone on the ridge.
windows.censor_note: dried blood and a swollen, split eye on Bank's face in the opening close-up, which fills the frame; blood smears on his shirt in the wider shots

windows.action: Tight on Bank's muddy shoes picking their way along the rutted track, then the camera pulls back to a wide of him walking off down the dump road with a stray dog standing in his path.
Bank staggers, pitches forward and ends face-down in the mud; by the last shot he is back on his feet, small in the grey haze, walking on under circling birds.

On a school rooftop a classmate in glasses holds forth to Pat, Grace and Lynn. Lynn turns a tiny object over in her fingers while Grace argues back, and by the last shot both girls have gone quiet and are just listening.
The classmate lifts his phone - an insert shows a STIC group chat on screen - and the table leans in. Grace and Lynn crowd the handset, and Pat ends the moment staring at it open-mouthed.
The classmate keeps talking with his eyes shut, pleased with himself; the girls' faces tighten and Lynn puts a hand to her forehead, and he closes the moment grinning straight at them.
Bank, face bloodied and school shirt filthy, stumbles crying through a vast garbage dump looking for a way out; by the last shot he has stopped running and sits collapsed in the mud, howling alone.
Two schoolgirls sit outdoors listening to someone off-camera, then the film cuts away to uniformed students filing up a brass staircase past a sign for the STIC seminar.

A figure stands silhouetted in a spotlight, back to a dark hall of seated students; the lights shift and reveal a grinning presenter in a black turtleneck with a mic, working the stage under a huge STIC logo.
Lynn and a bespectacled classmate stand pressed against a side wall of the darkened hall, watching the stage, then the view widens to rows of uniformed students, several of them slumped and bored.
The camera drifts across a blank white board, then finds Lynn in a red t-shirt standing in a cluttered print workshop, answering an unseen questioner.

Grace and Pat sit side by side in the same workshop, eyes down; cut to Lynn with arms folded, looking away as she talks; then an insert of a whiteboard listing the exam's four sections and its breaks.
Wide of Grace perched on a workbench with Pat slouched beside her; Lynn stands alone in front of the timetable board; back on the bench, Pat has sat up and started writing on a sheet of paper.

A hand holds up a pencil so its printed barcode fills the frame; the same barcode appears blown up on the projection screen, and a wide pulls back to the presenter alone in a spotlight before the seated students.

A barcode fills a projection screen; the frame widens to a girl in school uniform presenting it on a dark auditorium stage. The slide then tags two bars 'A' and 'B', and the seated students watch, grinning.
Pat takes the spotlight in front of a slide of a giant 2B pencil carrying the same barcode, turning a real pencil in his fingers; the cut then drops him entirely and leaves only the pencil on screen.

Cutaways out of the hall: Lynn reads an exam booklet aloud among printing presses, a laughing boy and girl plant coloured flag pins across a map beside an STIC box, then Lynn turns away from the booklet.
Back on stage Pat speaks in half-light; a wide shows the uniformed girl at the lectern under the pencil slide, then Pat swings round to the crowd mid-shout, the pitch turning into a performance.
Pat works the edge of the blank screen with his shadow thrown huge across it, arms open to the room, then the camera tightens to a dark profile as he lowers the pencil and quiets down.
Cut away to a laundry: Bank, framed through a doorway with an armful of white sheets, stops and looks off to one side, alone and nowhere near the auditorium.
In a darkened school hall, students in uniform clap and cheer while a boy dances alone in a spotlight on stage; by the last shots the crowd is out of their seats, one boy flailing into the aisle.
Hard cut out of the hall to a dim back room: a held close-up on Bank, a dark bruise under his eye, staring off while a hand passes through the foreground.
Daylight on the laundry's open wooden door and its posted price list; Lynn walks in off the bright street and disappears inside.
A long take shot through the hanging clothes racks: Lynn stands alone in the shop with her back to camera, then Bank comes out to the counter and stops opposite her.
Lynn and Bank talk in matched singles across the shop, she in front of the shelves of wrapped laundry, he by the irons and the wall calendar. Neither crosses to the other.
Bank stands at the ironing table in his family's laundry and looks up, startled, mid-sentence. Lynn comes in past the shelves of wrapped laundry, talking, until she is standing in his workroom.
Bank faces her across the shop, guarded; Lynn answers from by the window. She stops moving and drops her eyes, so the two of them are left standing still on opposite sides of the room.
The coverage tightens to over-the-shoulder singles. Bank listens with his eyes down, Lynn presses her case, and by the last shot he has lifted his head and is looking straight back at her.

Lynn holds a long beat with her eyes lowered while Bank stares up at her, giving nothing. The talk ends in an insert: her hand slides a small card across an open ledger beside a calculator, to his hand on the pen.
Lynn waits, Bank looks off past her, still not answering. Then his hand comes down on the ledger and picks the card up - the refusal has turned into him taking it.

Cut outside to the carved sign of a printing house, then a hand throwing breakers in a dark fuse panel. Lynn walks onto the shop floor as the lights come up, and a silhouette moves ahead of her into the dark.

Lynn walks into the dim printing works while a figure waits in the dark. She turns, and Bank steps forward under a strip light. By the last shot she is smiling faintly, Pat and Grace hanging back behind her.
The camera tilts up over the works' girders and the painted SAFETY FIRST slogan, then drops to the floor, where Pat is propped against an offset press and Grace turns away in the foreground.
Lynn and Bank trade looks in profile across the press floor. Over the long final take Lynn goes from staring off to talking, dropping her eyes as she lays out the plan.

A STIC registration form fills in as Lynn works from a laptop on the press step. Two completed admission tickets flash up, Thanaphon's then Rinrada's, and the frame widens to Pat and Lynn enrolling side by side.

Hands fill in an application form clipped to a passport photo while Grace and Pat wait at the table. The run jumps home: Lynn's father soaping the car at night, then Lynn standing over him as he reads her papers.

On a MacBook a "Teen Genius" logo is cut out in Photoshop and dropped onto a letterhead as a hand works the mouse. Grace types at a second laptop, and the run ends on a blurred arm whipping past the lens.

Lynn brings the printed letter to her father. He keeps scrubbing the car, then turns to look up at her; by the last shot he is on his feet outside, the page in his hands and Lynn leaning in beside him.
Outside the house Lynn's father talks to a visitor beside a parked car; the film cuts indoors to the print shop, where Bank stares off and the four of them are gathered among the presses.

The plan is staged in school uniform under the SAFETY FIRST sign: Pat stands over Grace at the press, then Bank and Lynn sit at two lone desks in the empty hall, then back to Pat talking down at Grace.

A hand turns the STIC practice booklet open beside an answer sheet, then title cards count off Sections 1, 2 and 3 over Bank and Lynn at the desks - their uniforms swapped for street clothes as the drills repeat.
Lynn, arms folded against a press, lays out the scheme; Pat reaches up to rig something overhead beside a laptop, and a wide shot shows the shop floor dressed as an exam room with two desks.

Bank scowls over his open book at the rehearsal desk while Lynn hovers behind him, then leans across the table pressing her case. By the last shot she is down at his level, smiling, and he is looking back warily.

Lynn turns to Pat and Grace and the timed run begins: Bank shoves his desk forward and goes, the three of them yelling and waving him on, until all that is left in frame are his legs sprinting past the shutters.
Bank, back in his plaid shirt, talks it through; the film cuts to a murky view of a real exam hall seen through a grate, then to students queuing to push fistfuls of banknotes at a collector.

The meeting loosens up: Lynn walks off with her head down past a seated Grace, Bank crosses the shop floor, and Pat moves in at Grace's shoulder before settling onto the edge of the old press beside her.
A hand drags an office chair across the shop floor; intercut, Bank sprints down the hall in his grey tee. Back at the meeting he is the one sitting in that chair, looking up at the others.

A cut of Bank sprinting down an open walkway drops into the print shop, where Bank sits apart, Pat and Grace listen from the press, and by the last shot Lynn is the one talking in front of the machine.

A phone calculator reads 7,500,000 and Bank looks up at it; the figure turns into a duffel bag stuffed with banknotes and three faces lit over it at night, then back to the wide print shop with Lynn standing over the others.

Bank bolts out a door; between Pat weighing it up and Bank sitting silent, the method plays out - a phone taped inside a lifted toilet cistern lid, Bank reading the paper, then thumbs typing the answers out.
Pat and Grace huddle over a phone and grin as the answers land, Lynn talks on smiling, Pat laughs with an arm round Grace - and it ends on Bank alone, head dropped, not sharing any of it.
An overhead insert of the open bag of banknotes, then Lynn lying back in the dark in phone light, before the picture drops to full black.

A long overhead take of a school stairwell - a student in uniform crouched beside a wooden ramp, others passing below - then the camera finds Lynn alone further up, leaning on the white railing and looking back.
Pat, in a floral shirt, is crying in a bare dark room; at the interrogation table he buries his face in both hands, then lifts it again, wet-eyed, to appeal to someone off camera.

Opens on a near-black frame, then the dim station office: Pat talks across the desk at Lynn's back. The wide reverse reveals the room - Lynn seated writing, Grace waiting at the wall, Bank standing apart.
Pat jabs a finger at Lynn, arguing; she keeps her eyes on the papers in her hands. By the last shot his hand is down and he has folded into a pleading clasp, head bowed.
Bank watches in profile, Grace blurred behind him. Pat leans in talking again, and the wide shot ends on Lynn bent over the desk, pen moving, writing the statement out.
Pat raises his voice at Lynn; the cut lands on Bank's face in tight profile, jaw set. Back on Pat, the fight has gone out of him and he sits silent as Lynn's hand stays on the page.
Bank comes over the desk at Pat in a blur of handheld cuts; Lynn springs up screaming. The two go down and the moment ends with both sprawled on the floor by the green wall, Bank on top.

Lynn lunges in and hauls at Bank's sweater, trying to drag him off; Grace claps both hands over her mouth, crying. The scuffle breaks and the last shot sits behind Bank's blue shoulder, pulled back from the desk.
Pat is down on the floor against the green wall and Grace flinches away in tears; Pat scrambles back up and lunges in again. Ends on a cutaway to a bare desk with one sheet of paper on it.
Bank pushes away through the back room with Lynn behind him while Lynn shoves Pat back against the blinds; by the last shot Bank has turned round at the lockers and is shouting at them.
Bank grabs Pat by the collar and throat until Lynn hauls Pat clear; Bank keeps yelling with Grace behind him, and the moment ends with Pat and Lynn pressed to the blinds, taking it in silence.
Grace locks her arms around Bank from behind to hold him back; the film then cuts outside to the lit room seen small through a barred night window, the fight suddenly distant.
One long take: Bank drives Pat across the room and slams him against the wooden door, but by the end Pat has turned it round, gripping Bank's shirt and arguing back inches from his face.
Cut away to Lynn and Grace standing helpless by the green wall, Grace crying; back at the door Bank's shouting has broken into tears while Pat holds him pinned by the collar.

At the wooden door under a JESUS plaque, Bank has Pat by the collar and they shout nose to nose through a flurry of short cuts; the burst ends on Lynn and Grace standing frozen in the laundry, watching.

The fight settles into one long face-off, Pat smirking while Bank shouts him down, until Bank turns away to the door. The wide that follows shows Pat walking out into the dark with his bag, the girls left lit behind the window.
Inside the laundry Grace is crying beside Lynn; Lynn then turns her back on her and faces Bank across the room, where he stands by the barred window wiping his face.
Lynn holds Bank's look in close-up, then the camera pulls outside to the window: she is gone from the lit room, leaving Grace alone with Bank, whose back finally fills the glass.
Lynn strides past the camera and away through the folding gate toward the stairwell, going out of focus as she reaches the stairs.
On a night footbridge Pat walks alone with his bag, from his feet on the painted line to a wide of him; he glances off to the side once and keeps walking away down the empty walkway.
Lynn stands in a lit school gateway, close to tears; three quick dark cuts flash in of her face with blood under her nose, and the last leaves her turned away into shadow.
A woman in a patterned dress faces Lynn in the corridor. The exchange tightens from a wary two-shot into singles: the woman's face buckles as she talks, while Lynn holds her ground.
Bank, out of focus and head down among street lights, walks on until he stops dead in front of a lit laundry-detergent billboard and stands staring up at it.
Wide through the open folding gates: Lynn and the woman stand metres apart. The woman closes the gap pleading, and the moment ends on an insert of her hand gripping Lynn's wrist.
The woman keeps pleading, face crumpling; Lynn swings round and shouts back at her, the exchange flipping from begging to open confrontation.
One long held take on the woman: she starts speaking quietly with her eyes shut, then breaks into a laugh through the tears, Lynn only a blur at the edge of frame.
Lynn listens in profile, unmoved, while the woman sobs openly; the moment pulls back to the wide and leaves the two of them still standing apart in the empty corridor.
A lit pedestrian overpass at night, lane signals glowing green arrow and red X. Cut in to Lynn alone at the rail, hand clamped over her mouth; she turns away, fighting tears.
Bank, in a blue polo, walks up the ramp past the foliage onto the bridge; the cut lands tight on his face as he stops and fixes on her, breathing hard.
Lynn jabs a finger at Bank as she argues, shot against the bridge trusses; from behind his shoulder she keeps at him, and by the last shot her hand has dropped and her face hardens.
Bank answers in profile, jaw set and eyes forward. The long reverse holds on Lynn listening; she stares off, then slowly turns her head toward him as the take ends.
A tight two-shot puts their faces inches apart over city bokeh, Bank talking, Lynn unblinking; the film pulls back to a wide of the pair as small figures on the lit overpass.
Night: two figures cross a lit footbridge over a highway past green-arrow and red-X lane signs. Cut to Bank and Lynn sitting side by side in a dark red-seated cabin, both staring ahead, not speaking.
Daylight abroad: a gull on a railing against a soft-focus harbour skyline, then a wide platform silhouette where Bank and Lynn stand well apart with their bags, a bridge and cruise liner behind them.
Framed through a stone arch, Bank and Lynn stand at a harbour railing with the opera house across the water, bags set down at their feet; they hold the same side-by-side pose for the whole long take.
Tight reverses start: Bank, low angle with the bridge behind him, talks with his head lowered; Lynn, shot over his shoulder, stays turned away and looks out at the water instead of at him.
Lynn turns into profile and answers while Bank drops his eyes further; by the end of the run she has swung further round toward him and is doing the talking.
Bank lifts his head and looks off past her; Lynn watches him, faintly frowning; Bank then settles back into still profile, facing the water rather than her.
Lynn and Bank sit by Sydney Harbour talking without facing each other; Bank turns off toward the bridge and by the last shot Lynn is alone in frame, staring across the water at the Opera House.

The two sit shoulder to shoulder squinting into the sun, saying nothing; the film then pulls back to a wide of the harbour where they are two small figures standing at the railing, bags at their feet.
A red Thai title card on black breaks off the Sydney scene; it cuts to Lynn alone in a hotel bathroom, hair wet, wrapped in a towel, holding her own stare in the mirror.
Bank eats a banana alone in an empty diner until the wall TV cuts to a STIC flash-news bulletin on tighter monitoring; he stops chewing and sits staring up at the screen.

Lynn strides out through the hotel lobby past reception; by the end she and Bank are on a train sharing one set of earphones over his phone, reading the STIC news story, her eyes shut, his face tight.
Arrival at the test centre: an empty wall with a NO SMOKING sign, then a STIC REGISTRATION sign, an empty lobby floor, and finally an overhead shot of candidates flooding in across the tiles.

A grey-suited official briefs the assembled candidates from below a crest; an insert shows a wrist watch being unclasped. Lynn and Bank, first just faces in the crowd, end tilted up at him, hands empty.
Bank walks into the men's toilet past the stalls with a bundled jacket. Overhead shots then show two adjacent cubicles being entered and the doors shut, one occupant each.
In the dark a flat rectangle is uncovered; Lynn pulls the lead out of a mechanical pencil. A watched hand holds a phone taped under a white tray, and by the last shot the tray is on Lynn's lap.
Lynn swings round to the partition and Bank's face appears framed in a gap in it; the screen blacks out, then overhead shots show both reaching across toward the hole from their own cubicles.
Bank checks the corridor from the toilet doorway and slips out; Lynn stays hidden behind the door frame, then leans out and looks back the other way once he has gone.
A pencil gripped tight at Lynn's hip as she passes a blurred invigilator; she climbs the stairs with Bank trailing, and the shot ends tilted up into the beamed ceiling of the exam hall.
Back in the library hall Lynn stands at her desk as the invigilator crosses the room; the woman walks out through the dark doorway, and Lynn and Bank are left turning to look after her.
An invigilator in a pale blazer walks toward the dark doorway of the library exam hall; Lynn and Bank look up from their desks, then the digital clock above the door reads 8:29:58.
A candidate flips the STIC booklet open, the pages spread; Lynn starts writing on her lap-desk with Bank beside her, and the wide of the hall ends with every row already bent over the paper.
Lynn reads, her watched hand moving over the answer grid; inserts of question 17, the clock at 8:51, then bubbles filling in until the pencil reaches question 26 - she has run deep into the section.
Lynn writes head-down in the row, then the scene shifts to Bank: tight on his face as he mouths to himself, then wide at his desk where he glances off and settles back into writing.
Hands ink answers onto the STIC Section 1 sheet; Bank mouths silently and Pat, rows away, raises a hand to his face. The last shot holds on fingers laid flat across the half-filled grid.
Bank frowns over his paper and Lynn stares down at hers, both tightening; the clock above the door turns 9:09:59 and the camera whips off it into a smear of red - the time is nearly gone.
A pencil darkens bubble 52-C, the shot holds long on 51-B and 52-C, then both hands spread flat over the finished Section 1 grid - the sheet is now complete to the last row.
In the wood-panelled exam hall Lynn mouths answers off her paper and Bank screws his eyes shut memorising; by the last shot both have dropped their heads over their desks, working in silence.
Inserts of a bubble sheet, blurred then sharp, showing two numbering runs (47/44, 48/45) filled in; Lynn's eyes stay shut as she recites. The run ends on the hall clock reading 9:14:59.
Lynn, seated behind Bank, looks off toward the invigilator, who stands talking at the front desk. Focus racks from Bank to Lynn and by the last shot she is on her feet, moving away from her chair.
Bank walks away from camera into the dark doorway; Lynn stands among the seated candidates staring ahead. The wide shot leaves both gone down the aisle and out the door, clock now 9:15:31.

Cut to night at a shuttered Thai printing house; inside, a whiteboard maps the STIC sections, timings and phones. Grace turns wide-eyed to Pat in the dark room, and the moment ends on hands typing a chat message.
A ceiling dome camera in the hall, then its own grainy feed: at 09:15:57 a blonde girl crosses the corridor, and three seconds later a boy in a grey sweatshirt stops at the stairwell marked 1.

Back at the printing house yard a man in a blue polo stands before a crowd of students, then ranks of helmeted motorbike couriers wait beside them; the wide shot shows the two lines drawn up facing each other.
Bank threads past other boys in the washroom, presses a hand to a toilet fitting and crouches at the wall; by the last shot he is sitting in the stall peeling a phone out of plastic taped to a lid.

In two toilet stalls, hands peel a phone out of its plastic wrap - Bank's first, then Lynn's. Lynn bows over her screen, and by the last shot the chat is already filled with answer strings being thumbed in.
Bank hunches over the phone in his stall, reading the blocks of letters and typing more of them. His face goes from flat concentration to a deep frown as the message on screen keeps growing.
One long held take on Bank in the stall: he stares at the phone, jaw tight, then both hands come up to grip his collar, face damp and breathing hard - from reading to near-panic without a cut.
Extreme close-up on Bank's closed eyes, sweat beaded on the skin. He opens them and the frame pulls back to him turned to the phone again, settled and deliberate.
The LINE group 'L,B' is packed with answer blocks and a thumb scrolls them. Lynn watches from her stall, then the screen shows her starting a Thai reply instead of more letters.

Cut to a dark room in Thailand at 5:19am: Pat and Grace lean into one phone and send that they are ready. Nothing comes back, so they send 'Bank?' - by the last shot Pat is talking fast, lit only by the screen.

Lynn, shut in a toilet stall, stares at her phone; an insert shows the chat where Bank demands one million more. By the last shot the cut has moved to Pat, alone in another stall, reading the same line.

In the laundry workshop Bank erupts, pounding the bench with both fists; a phone insert carries his ultimatum to transfer within five minutes. By the last shot he has turned on the woman in the blue uniform, who recoils behind the table.

Bank screams across the table at the woman in blue; she grabs at his hands, crying, until he stoops away and retreats into the dark machine floor. The moment ends on her left alone at the glass desk, head down.

Screen inserts fill the thread as Bank prices it out - first million the fee, second for the beating - cutting back to Pat in his stall. He shifts from slack-mouthed disbelief to a hard frown by the last shot.
Pat thumbs a reply; the chat shows a bank transfer slip and a message that this is all that is in the account, the rest after the answers come. Pat's face closes from shock into a scowl.

Lynn watches the thread from her stall, tight-faced; a hand holds the phone up on the transfer slip. It ends on Bank perched on a laundry table beside the woman in blue, the two of them quietly reading his phone together.

Fast montage: an Illustrator file maps barcodes to answers 1A-5C, then a hand hits a green machine's button and presses start. Cuts move off the screen onto the running press and onto Lynn hunched close over the work.

Lynn, sweating, watches the machine run; a bare steel bed with a card marked '1' fills with a heap of black pencils, a barcode strip is peeled off, and the camera pulls back to the whole print shop with Lynn and Bank bent over the bench.
Bank strides down a wood-panelled corridor on exam day; Lynn joins him and they walk away from camera together, ending on the digital clock above the hall door reading 9:25:43.
Lynn walks into the library exam hall past rows of seated candidates, finds her chair and lowers her head; the view widens to the full hall with the invigilator standing alone in the doorway.
Lynn sits with her eyes down; Bank turns in his seat and looks straight at her. She lifts her head and returns the look, the exchange ending with her holding his gaze instead of avoiding it.
Insert on the booklet header 'SECTION 2 Writing and Language Test, 44 questions, 25 minutes', then macro shots of a pencil tip filling bubbles - the last one blacking in B.
The hall clock hits 9:49:59; over the invigilator's shoulder the room is still writing, and she looks up as it rolls to 9:50:01. Bank works head-down, then Lynn raises her face from her desk.
'SECTION 3 Math Test - Grid-In, 16 questions, 20 minutes'. Lynn glances to the front of the hall, then bends down and works, the pencil scratching out x2, x5/2 before moving onto the grid-in boxes.
A pencil prints a digit into the grid boxes and Lynn's hands flatten the booklet. She works beside Bank, and by the last shots he is sweating hard down his face as 0.72 goes into the grid.

The exam runs: a hand works an answer sheet, Lynn and Bank sit rows apart. It tightens from wide desks to sweat running down Bank's and Lynn's faces, cut with inserts of grid-in boxes reading 0.72 and 11160.

A blurred whip past a candidate settles on Lynn's face, jaw working as she mouths something, eyes down. The camera then pulls back to the full library hall, Bank and Lynn small at separate desks among rows of candidates.
A cubicle door and its latch, then a lurching handheld move along the washroom wall past two blonde girls at the mirrors, ending on Lynn stopped inside the toilets, looking off and listening.

In the locked cubicle Bank peels a phone out of a sanitary-pad wrapper on his lap; Lynn turns away outside. He wakes the screen and starts typing answer strings - BCADB DCDAC BDABC - under earlier blocks already marked read.
Lynn checks her wristwatch and looks down, strained. Cut to the phone as Bank types 'next, grid-in' and sends it, then to Bank in the stall, mouth open, waiting on the screen.

Two men in suits walk into the washroom talking. Bank's head snaps up at the noise, then he bends back to the phone to type grid-in values 0.72, 107, 23, 0 - and his face lifts again, frightened, as the voices get closer.

The suited invigilator moves down the stalls with a second man behind him. Bank adds one more number, 5, then abandons the message: he backs out to the chat list and opens the menu to Remove the thread 'L,P'.
Hunched in a toilet stall, Bank stares at his phone and thumbs open the chat thread to delete it; outside, two suited proctors stop at the stall doors, and he lifts his head toward the voices.
The bagged tablet sits on Bank's knees, then lies on the stall floor by his sneakers; a proctor's dress shoes stop beside it, both men look down, and Bank is left staring at the floor.
Cut to the women's room: Lynn moves along the tiled wall in her argyle sweater, head down and hands at her chest, a figure reflected in the far mirror behind her.
Bank hauls the toilet lid up with both hands; an insert shows his stall latch thrown shut. He ends bowed over the open bowl, hands braced on the seat, still not letting go.
The phone drops into the bowl, his hand hits the flush, and it spirals away under the water. His head snaps up, and outside the suited proctor tilts his face up at the stall door.
Overhead, Lynn crouches at the cistern of her stall, then sits with the bagged tablet on her lap; her hands go still and she jerks her face up, mouth open, at a sound outside.
The woman proctor walks the row of stall doors, talking. Inside, Lynn looks up, then plants a bare foot on the cistern and climbs out of sight while the proctor keeps scanning the doors.
Lynn is out at the sinks with her head down, the proctor standing at the stall row behind her in the mirror; the moment closes on an insert of her black boots planted on the tiles.
Close on a pair of black boots planted on a tiled floor, then a cut to Lynn in tight profile, mouth open mid-shout. The moment goes from still, anonymous feet to Lynn yelling at someone off-screen.

In a wood-panelled corridor a grey-haired man in a suit jabs a finger at Bank against a glass door; a reverse shows Lynn frozen in the doorway watching. By the last shot the man has seized Bank's jacket.
Lynn's sweating, crumpling face fills the frame; the corridor reverse finds her still standing in the doorway behind the suited man. She ends by turning and walking away from camera down the hall.
Wide of the lift lobby: students stand with arms raised while staff pat them down and a crouching woman checks their shoes. The run ends on Lynn walking straight at camera, past a water cooler.

Close inserts at the water cooler: a hand works the tap, a hand dips to her boot, fingers tear open a small wrapper, a cup is lifted. She ends walking away from the cooler, hands held behind her back.

Out of focus, then sharp: Lynn reaches a desk in the library exam hall and sets her board down. An invigilator passes a clock reading 10:20:00; the wide ends with Lynn seated among rows of candidates.
Tight on Lynn's hands: she holds a pencil poised over blank paper, then the tip comes down and she starts writing. The cut out is a medium of her head bowed, candidates working behind her.
Lynn hunches over her desk in the exam hall, pencil scratching answer letters into the margin of her sheet. The opening hand insert widens to the whole hall, then closes back on her sweating face.
The pencilled code grows from one row of letters to two. Between inserts Lynn's face tightens, and by the last shot her eyes are screwed shut and a hand is raised beside her head.
The Section 4 maths booklet opens: 30 questions, 35 minutes. The pencil skims a question, fills bubble 8, moves to another, and by the last insert it is darkening number 30.
Lynn's face runs with sweat as she finishes. An overhead shows the Section 4 grid fully bubbled with letter rows and figures written beneath it, then she lifts her head and stares up off-camera.
A hand works across an answer sheet, a sweating face bears down on it, then fingers flatten over the pencilled letter rows to hide them as black boots pass along the carpet between desks.
Lynn sits with eyes shut and mouth open, a palm spread over her written code. She drops her head, then twists round in her seat, arm braced on the chair back, to look behind her.
Montage: an empty rehearsal-room piano cuts against Lynn's closed eyes and macro shots of her pencilled letters - A A D, C D B, B C A, B D A - each answered by a tighter angle on the keyboard.
Lynn sits mid-row in the exam hall, eyes shut over her paper. The angle swings behind her to the hall clock at 10:42:11, and the doorway ahead fades through into a dark room with an upright piano.
Extreme close-ups of Lynn's sweating brow and tight face; an insert shows a pencilled letter string C B A A D on blank paper. She is back upright in the stacks, writing steadily.
Cuts alternate between Lynn at the lamplit piano and Lynn bent over her desk in the hall. The run ends on the paper, where the letter string has grown to D P B C A D B D.
Lynn frowns down at her sheet, then her fingers start drumming the desktop; the cut matches them to hands running real piano keys and back to the silent tapping on the exam paper.
Lynn's sweat-sheened profile in the piano room, then upright in the stacks reading her sheet; an insert shows answer bubbles already shaded in, and she ends breathing hard, mouth open.

A held wide of Lynn's back at the upright piano, window light behind her, breaks into a whip-pan blur and lands on the proctor in the cream blazer planted in the hall doorway, hands on hips, watching.
The intercut speeds up: blurred piano playing, Lynn writing at her desk, filled C and D bubbles, fingers on keys. It ends tight on her hand tapping in the foreground with her face soft behind it.
A new location: a dim print works full of old presses. A phone left on a desk lights up with an incoming call from 0840126470, and the cut goes outside to the shop's Thai signboard.
A long static hold on a car's rear window carrying a handwritten paper advert; the number on it, 084-012-6470, is the one that just rang at the print shop.
A hand holds a phone reading 6:58, Sat Oct 8; two students compare their screens in a packed hall; the camera pans a rank of waiting motorbike taxis and settles on a wall clock ticking to 6:59.

A blurred pan across a rank of orange-vested motorbike riders, then a wall clock reading 6:59 on 18-10-2016; cut to a second digital clock on wood panelling reading 10:57:59, moving the action to the exam hall.
A proctor in a cream blazer stares down the room; Lynn sits with her eyes shut, then a hand sweeps over the answer sheet and the paper turns to the 'Essay' section and its Witwatersrand heading.
Lynn bends over the paper reading the Nelson Mandela speech prompt dated July 16, 2003. By the last shot she has lifted her head slightly, face damp with sweat and brow pinched.

Lynn stops writing and looks off to the side across the library; an insert shows her pencil lying idle on the desk. She tilts her face up, and a wide shot reveals her alone among rows of writing candidates.

Lynn holds the pencil upright in front of her face, steadying herself, then doubles into a cough behind her fist. Her other hand clamps the desk edge, and the coughing grows harder and more visible to the room.
A flurry of extreme close-ups: her neck, eye and open mouth, ending on her own fingers pushed between her lips - she is deliberately forcing the fit rather than suffering it.
